description: Central Provincial Council - Draft Enactment to establish a Department for Cultural Affairs of the Central Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the establishment of a new legal/regulatory framework - a draft enactment to create a Department for Cultural Affairs for the Central Provincial Council. It outlines the legal authority, objectives, duties, and powers of the new department, including regulatory functions over cultural activities, preservation of monuments, and management of museums. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves the creation of new regulations and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization without legal framework creation.
